name: agentic-sdd
description: Agentic, spec-driven development pipeline (require -> plan -> analyze -> implement -> verify -> fix) gated by a persistent per-feature status file, grounded in each target repo's real conventions via a profile/constitution system, and knowledge-grounded through optional MCP tools (a knowledge-base search server, a wiki server) that degrade gracefully when not connected. Fully standalone: no dependency on any other plugin or repo.
